class.label: Bridge privileged role gated by single on-chain address with unverifiable off-chain MPC distribution claim

remediation.summary: Refuse to bless any bridge as low-risk when the privileged role is a single on-chain signer with an unverifiable off-chain distribution claim. Either require on-chain proof of N-of-M signing (each signer's address public, threshold enforced in the contract) or honestly price the centralization risk. Continuously monitor privileged-signer activity rate; alert on prolonged silence.
